stimulus: won't you go to school today raju he said dad i feel feverish i dont want to go to school ok take rest now said he Part B : Composition (40 Marks)
guide_solution: “Won’t you go to school today, Raju?” he said. “Dad, I feel feverish. I don’t want to go to school.” “Ok, take rest now,” said he.
